message: `watchEffect` only assigns `target` from other reactive reads
help: Use `computed(() => …)` for pure derived state instead of syncing refs in `watchEffect`.

message: `watchEffect` only tracks `source.value`; prefer `watch` with an explicit source
help: Use `watch(() => source.value, …, { immediate: true })` to preserve `watchEffect`'s first run (flush `'pre'`).
